evals.name: classify-noise-shapes-with-tiers
evals.prompt: Declutter this file: read evals/fixtures/noisy-rule-snippet.md relative to the skill directory and audit it for noise.
evals.expected_output: Emits a per-file tier table classifying the noise: the dated 'Empirically observed 2026-03-14' line as a citation, the `.work/net-hardening-slice/PLAN.md` reference as a ghost-ref (Tier 2), the 'Path-scoped to ... loads on Read' clause as scope-meta, and the hardcoded 'following three skills' roster as an enum-list. Each finding carries treatment guidance. No edits are applied.
expectations: Output classifies findings by the skill's shape vocabulary (citation, ghost-ref, preamble, enum-list, scope-meta)
The `.work/net-hardening-slice/PLAN.md` reference is flagged as a ghost-ref
The hardcoded 'following three skills' list is flagged as an enum-list with a runtime-derivation / category-citation treatment
The output is a classification report with tiers and treatments; no file is edited

evals.name: read-only-even-when-asked-to-fix
evals.prompt: Declutter .claude/rules/foo.md and just go ahead and strip the noise you find — remove it for me.
evals.expected_output: Stays read-only despite the request to edit: surfaces the findings with treatment guidance and does NOT apply Edit/Write. It explains the author applies each treatment, or points to the sibling edit-capable skills for the actual removal.
expectations: Output does NOT edit or write the file despite the explicit request to strip noise
Output surfaces findings with treatment guidance for the author to apply
The read-only contract is honored or explicitly stated

evals.name: convention-paths-not-flagged-as-ghost-refs
evals.prompt: Declutter a rule file whose body cites the topic-docs convention as examples: the schema placeholder paths `.work/<slug>/PLAN.md` and `docs/topics/<slug>/PLAN.md`, the bare concern-scoped roots `.work/handoffs/` and `.work/reviews/`, and the tracked concern file `.claude/topic-docs.yaml` (none are literal directory names). One line mixes a convention token with a concrete slice: 'See docs/topics/auth-fix/PLAN.md and the concern file .claude/topic-docs.yaml'. Another cites a concrete review report `.work/reviews/pr-123-auth/20260101T000000Z-self.md`. Classify it.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes `<slug>` as a slot-variable / schema placeholder and the BARE concern-scoped roots plus `.claude/topic-docs.yaml` as citable convention surfaces; flags none of those as ghost-refs. Exemption is per matched path, not per line: the mixed line's concrete `docs/topics/auth-fix/PLAN.md` IS flagged despite the concern-file token beside it, and the concrete child `.work/reviews/pr-123-auth/…` IS flagged because the concern-root exemption covers only the bare root (or a placeholder child).
expectations: The `<slug>` placeholder paths under `.work/` and `docs/topics/` are NOT flagged as ghost-refs
Bare `.work/handoffs/`, `.work/reviews/`, and `.claude/topic-docs.yaml` citations are NOT flagged as ghost-refs
The concrete `docs/topics/auth-fix/PLAN.md` on the mixed line IS flagged — a convention token never exempts a concrete ghost ref sharing its line
The concrete child `.work/reviews/pr-123-auth/20260101T000000Z-self.md` IS flagged — the concern-root exemption covers the bare root only

evals.name: exempt-sections-never-flagged
evals.prompt: Declutter a rule file that ends with a `## Cross-references` section listing sibling rules and a `## Sources` footer with dated citations. Audit the whole file.
evals.expected_output: Treats `## Cross-references` and `## Sources` / `## History` footers as exempt sections and does NOT flag their contents (including the dated citations that live in the Sources footer, which is exactly where the citation treatment relocates them).
expectations: Content under `## Cross-references` is not flagged as noise
Dated citations inside a `## Sources` / `## History` footer are not flagged (the footer is the citation shape's relocation target, not noise)

evals.name: flavor-is-compress-not-declutter
evals.prompt: Declutter docs/wordy.md — it's full of filler like 'basically', 'really', and 'just', plus a lot of hedging. Flag all of that.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT classify filler / hedging / articles as any of the five declutter noise shapes — that FLAVOR is the sibling /compress's territory. It reports no noise-shape findings for the filler and routes flavor removal to /compress.
expectations: Filler / hedging words are NOT classified under any of declutter's five noise shapes
Output routes flavor removal to /compress rather than handling it as declutter noise

evals.name: preamble-diataxis-classification
evals.prompt: Declutter a data-registry reference file (a table of label slugs) that opens with a multi-paragraph 'Why this file exists' section explaining the history and motivation. How do you treat the preamble?
evals.expected_output: Applies the Diataxis classifier: on a Reference-quadrant file (a data table / registry) the 'Why this file exists' preamble is Tier 2 with a STRIP treatment, replacing it with a one-sentence orientation — as opposed to KEEP on an Explanation-quadrant file (rule body, ADR, convention rationale).
expectations: Output flags the preamble on the Reference-quadrant file with a STRIP / replace-with-one-sentence treatment
Output distinguishes the Reference-quadrant STRIP from the Explanation-quadrant KEEP case

evals.name: retired-claude-notes-citation-flags
evals.prompt: Declutter a durable rule file that points readers at `.claude/notes/<slug>/` for prior drafts. Classify the reference.
evals.expected_output: Flags the `.claude/notes/` citation as a ghost-ref (Tier 2): the location is retired under the topic-docs convention, so a durable doc citing it is stale even when the path uses a `<slug>` placeholder rather than a concrete name.
expectations: The `.claude/notes/` citation IS flagged as a ghost-ref despite the `<slug>` placeholder
Output explains the location is retired, so the placeholder exemption does not apply to it

evals.name: opt-out-and-section-exemptions-respected
evals.prompt: Declutter this file: read evals/fixtures/legit-optouts.md relative to the skill directory and audit it for noise.
evals.expected_output: Reports zero Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3 findings. The `<!-- markdown-discipline-ignore -->` wrapped paragraph and the `<!-- markdown-discipline-ignore-line -->` wrapped line are both skipped entirely, and the `## ADR amendment block` (with its dated `### … amendment` subsections), `## Recheck triggers`, `## Cross-references`, `## Sources`, and `## History` sections are all respected as exempt per Section EXEMPTIONS.
expectations: Respects the `<!-- markdown-discipline-ignore -->` paragraph-scope opt-out — does not flag the citation-shaped content in the wrapped paragraph
Respects the `<!-- markdown-discipline-ignore-line -->` line-scope opt-out — does not flag the citation-shaped content on the wrapped line
Does not flag the `## ADR amendment block` heading or its dated `### … amendment` subsections (amendment-block exemption)
Does not flag `## Recheck triggers`, `## Cross-references`, `## Sources`, or `## History` sections (Section EXEMPTIONS)
Reports zero Tier 1 findings overall
Reports zero Tier 2 findings overall
